nodes.label: Neon database (production/development branches)
nodes.rationale: Pooled string -> DATABASE_URL, direct -> DIRECT_URL; never run prisma migrate dev against production.

nodes.label: Render web service for API
nodes.rationale: Native Node not Docker; paid instance to avoid cold starts; same region as Neon.

nodes.label: Vercel deployment for client
nodes.rationale: Only NEXT_PUBLIC_* vars; no server secrets on the client host.

nodes.label: Admin panel (/admin, seeded admin only)
nodes.rationale: No public sign-up; the only account is the seeded admin.

nodes.label: PR Checklist (build, check, env, migration, secrets)
nodes.norm_label: pr checklist (build, check, env, migration, secrets)

nodes.label: CLAWKIT website notes for Claude
nodes.rationale: Built from fullstack-web-scaffold; payments, uploads, cron, Redis and public user accounts deliberately left out and must not be stubbed.

nodes.label: Client service layer + single-flight 401 refresh
nodes.rationale: Components call src/services/index.js, never axios directly; api.js refreshes once on 401 with a shared promise. Only auth state in Zustand; server data via TanStack Query.

nodes.label: Website honeypot + client/server zod schema sync
nodes.norm_label: website honeypot + client/server zod schema sync
nodes.rationale: Contact/newsletter forms carry a 'website' honeypot; client zod schema must match server/src/validators/content.validators.js.

nodes.label: JWT access token + rotating refresh cookie
nodes.norm_label: jwt access token + rotating refresh cookie
nodes.rationale: HS256 access token 15m kept in memory only; refresh token in httpOnly cookie scoped to /api/v1/auth, hashed in DB, rotated with reuse detection per family.

nodes.label: Route-middleware-validator-controller layering
nodes.rationale: Routes hold no logic; zod validators precede controllers which use Prisma/services.

nodes.label: Express middleware order
nodes.rationale: helmet -> trust proxy -> HTTPS redirect -> CORS -> json -> cookies -> rate limit -> /health -> /api/v1 -> 404 -> errorHandler

nodes.label: CLIENT_URL must equal apex https://clawkit.us
nodes.rationale: Otherwise CORS and the refresh cookie fail; www 308-redirects to apex.

nodes.label: Manual migrations + admin seed from Render Shell
nodes.norm_label: manual migrations + admin seed from render shell
nodes.rationale: Migrations run by hand after schema-changing deploys; ADMIN_PASSWORD can be removed after seeding.

nodes.label: SMTP-less email logging fallback
nodes.rationale: Without SMTP_HOST, contact notifications and password resets are printed to the API log.
